prohibit: scientific promotion without matched strong baselines and independent assessment

research_question: Can learned reusable delexicalized natural-language patterns realize external human-authored structured meanings more faithfully than nearest raw reference retrieval, without becoming a hand-coded template engine that fabricates facts, and at what complete CPU/storage cost?

external_dataset.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; provide provenance, no verbatim raw text or mass example output in artifacts
external_dataset.test_policy: testset.csv and testset_w_refs.csv intentionally UNTOUCHED; no official held-out test first use
external_dataset.custody: Verify raw bytes exact and Git blob SHA1 of train and dev files BEFORE parsing; fail closed; keep raw CSV out of worktree and evidence artifacts

cohorts.TRAIN: First 700 source-ordered distinct canonical meaning representations with one associated human reference from trainset.csv; exact MR disjoint from dev cohorts
cohorts.SELECT: First 80 source-ordered distinct canonical MRs from devset.csv not in TRAIN, only development diagnostics, NO model/strategy selection
cohorts.DEV: Next 100 source-ordered distinct canonical MRs not in TRAIN/SELECT from devset.csv. Once exposed, permanently spent as public development evidence, NEVER scientific first-use
cohorts.schema: CSV columns 'mr','ref'; meaning parser extracts key[value] tuples and rejects duplicate keys, unsupported text or empty names; normalize MR keys only, keep value original case. Different refs for same MR not duplicated. Exact MR tuple no role overlap.

arms.REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL: Train-only nearest MR, score +3 attribute-value exact agreement, +1 same-key, -2 different value, -2 extra or missing key; emit raw human TRAIN ref unchanged, lexical memory baseline.
arms.DELEX_TEMPLATE: Learn pattern from each TRAIN reference by replacing matched literal MR values with placeholders; independently rank template by frozen MR similarity and number of covered slots. Fill only placeholders present in requested MR, no DEV-derived edits. May omit details/hallucinate, report faithfully.
arms.CONSTRAINED_TEMPLATE: Use same trained delexicalized candidates, select from first 32 by MR similarity, reject unfillable placeholder or obvious absent MR literal from training value inventory, maximize requested literal slot coverage; no oracle access or post-DEV fixes.
arms.CANONICAL_FACTS: Deterministic lossless slot serialization 'key is value' joined by semicolon; very strong auditable literal-fidelity baseline but intentionally NOT natural language fluency.

primary: exact MR key/value literal surface coverage on keys name/near/food/area/eattype; NOT semantic entailment
name and near strict literal recall when provided
training-known value hallucination indicator for name/near with explicit caution about ordinary-word matches
unigram token F1 vs one held human reference, not standard BLEU or human fluency assessment
novel exact MR vs TRAIN fraction and exact public generation SHA
cost: full raw saved learned template/checkpoint bytes
peak traced Python heap and process RSS
evaluation.limitations: Public E2E dataset and standard lexical audits, not independent blinded semantics, coding, math, reasoning, multilingual or open-ended language. No learned RNN/state-space/transformer capacity-matched baselines at this gate; scientific/Pareto GO categorically FORBIDDEN.
evaluation.regression: Native Windows/Linux exact original source SHA and 3 role SHA; 4 arms × 3 roles exact output digests/numeric public metrics, 12 adversarial source/model tests per OS, one Linux full Go test/vet/build, separate complete FORGE Windows/Linux PR regression.
evaluation.decision: Only prospective positive DEVELOPMENT signal if delex/constrained matches more specified literal facts than raw retrieval at measured bounded resource cost; false strict-copy or reference lexical overlap does not establish intelligence. Record all negatives, leave draft and unmerged.
